2026 Retro GEMPC prize playmat personalised with the GEMP handle AdamCFC of [[Adam Radic]]: an Imperial Star Destroyer on black, with the 2026 Retro GEMPC logo top left and the name bottom right. Adam Radic won one of the four random-draw playmat prizes of the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] (a 2026 Retro GEMPC playmat or $50 of SWCCG product).<ref name="t86969">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1450262#p1450262 2026 Retro GEMPC Random Prize Results], post by billbisco, forum.starwarsccg.org (7 September 2026).</ref>
